name: Documentation Updater
description: Automatically update documentation when source files change

action.request:
A source file has been modified. Please review the changes and update the relevant documentation:

1. If API endpoints or schemas changed, update docs/api.md
2. If architecture or core components changed, update ARCHITECTURE.md
3. If setup/installation process changed, update README.md and docs/development.md
4. If new dependencies were added, update the relevant documentation sections

Please analyze the changed files and determine which documentation needs to be updated to stay in sync with the code changes. Focus on keeping the documentation accurate and helpful for developers.
